title: "My Penguins"
format: html

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

## Summary table

```{r}
penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(avg_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n())
```
   Chinstrap and Gentoo penguins have noticeably longer bills than Adelie penguins.

## Plot

```{r}
   ggplot(penguins, aes(x = flipper_length_mm, y = body_mass_g, color = species)) + geom_point() + labs(title = "Flipper length vs body mass", x = "Flipper length (mm)", y = "Body mass (g)")
```
